content: Emerging models for delivering diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES) include the use of telehealth, virtual environments, and mobile health applications. These approaches expand access to DSMES and allow individuals to actively participate in their diabetes self-management from the comfort of their homes. Virtual environments, which may incorporate avatars that represent patients in interactive and gamified settings, have demonstrated significant potential in enhancing patient engagement and motivation. These improvements contribute to better overall diabetes management and outcomes. These innovative delivery methods highlight the critical need to tailor DSMES programs to meet the diverse and specific needs of different patient populations.
